newsitem.title: USA: Intl Panorama says Kakanda project ratified.
newsitem.headline: Intl Panorama says Kakanda project ratified.

text.p: International Panorama Resource Corp said on Tuesday that the new government of the Democratic Republic of Congo's Minister of Mines ratified the company's copper/cobalt project at Kakanda/Kambove.
A pre-feasibility study of the project released on May 27, 1997, indicates that the project could have annual production rates of 3,500 tonnes of cobalt and 45,000 tonnes of copper, the company said.
International Panorama said it is proceeding with a feasibility study and is commencing civil works later in 1997 with production scheduled to start in mid-1999.
